notes: Japanese-known course dominated by two artifact families. (1) Agglutinative endings/particles/copula/nominalisers (こと, です, ない, に, を, たい, つもりです, ました) glossed many contextual ways as role component -> most of the 70 fp_subgloss, including the top-6 mega-collisions at seeds 226-230 where one consistent drilled lego (man, that man, woman, trying to help, wants to work, is going to tell) is mis-keyed alongside dozens of USE sentences that merely embed it. (2) The bulk of the 89 real_consolidate are NOT vocabulary collisions but two near-identical English renderings of ONE whole Japanese sentence (that-drop I know that.../I know..., contraction it's/it is, want/I'd like, subject-drop, with/without a trailing clause) -- genuine ZUT but almost all low severity. Only 2 release blockers: わかりません (drilled lego split across understand/know/I'm not sure) and あまり (drilled very vs negative-polarity not much).
